name: "Impact" repulsor cannon
description: The "Impact" repulsor cannon, also known simply as the Impact cannon, was a model of repulsor cannon manufactured by Nova Design Arms. Designed as an alternative to other forms of non-lethal weaponry, the Impact cannon utilized a modified speeder bike repulsorlift to fire tight, narrow beams of energy to disrupt a target's actions at medium ranges. However, this effect only lasted as long as the beam remained focused on the target. Nova Design engineers installed a short-ranged grapple onto the weapon to help stabilize it. The Impact cannon's design was inspired by makeshift repulsor guns.
